title: SBU detains driver suspected of directing Russian attacks on Kyiv' regions thermal power plants
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) counterintelligence officers have detained a logistics company driver in the Kyiv region suspected of helping direct Russian strikes on local energy facilities at the direction of Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB).

title: Russia suffers record battlefield losses in October – General Staff
summary: As of October 29, Russian forces have suffered 49,040 personnel losses in combat this month, the highest monthly figure since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

title: National Guard troops strike Russian Molniya-13 mothership drone over Donetsk region
summary: Interceptor drone pilots from the Omega Special Operations Center of the National Guard of Ukraine detected and struck a Russian Molniya-13 mothership drone in the skies over the Donetsk region.

title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Kremenchuk district
summary: Russian forces attacked an industrial facility in the Kremenchuk district, Poltava region.

title: Russian attacks leave over 350,000 without power in Dnipro and surrounding area
summary: More than 350,000 consumers in Dnipro and surrounding settlements have been left without electricity following Russian attacks.

title: Military takes control of everything: Flash explains how private air defense works
summary: Private air defense is working effectively. Businesses are investing in infrastructure and electronic warfare networks, but the military is in charge of air defense operations.

title: Intelligence data: How many Su-34 fighter-bombers has Russia lost, and how many remain in service?
summary: Since the start of the full-scale war, 43 Russian Su-34 fighter-bombers have been destroyed, and another seven enemy aircraft of this type have been damaged.

title: National Bank revises 2026 real GDP forecast downward
summary: According to the National Bank’s updated forecast, Ukraine’s real gross domestic product (GDP) will contract by 0.4% in 2026.

title: Next UDCG meeting to take place in Brussels on Nov 17
summary: The next meeting of the Ukraine Defense Contact Group will take place in Brussels on November 17.

title: Defense forces strike Iskander-M launcher in Russia’s Kursk region
summary: On October 29 and during the night of October 30, the Ukrainian Defense Forces struck an “Iskander-M” tactical missile system launcher in the Kursk Oblast of the Russian Federation, as well as ammunition depots, logistics facilities, and repair units of the Russian Army.

title: Humanitarian aid reaches residents of Oleshky
summary: Humanitarian aid has been delivered to residents of the temporarily occupied town of Oleshky in the Kherson region.

title: Russian forces strike facility in Chernihiv
summary: On Friday, October 30, Russian troops attacked a facility in Chernihiv, causing a vehicle on the premises to catch fire.

title: Russian forces strike Dnipro again
summary: The enemy army struck Dnipro.

title: Ukraine imposes new sanctions on Russia's Rassvet satellite system, 39 shadow fleet vessels
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has enacted a National Security and Defense Council decision imposing sanctions on Russian companies and individuals involved in developing the Rassvet satellite communications system, as well as on 39 vessels belonging to Russia's shadow fleet.

title: No ceasefire violations reported in Oleshky over past 75 hours – Lubinets
summary: Neither side has violated the ceasefire in Oleshky over the past 75 hours.

title: Russian attacks leave consumers without power in Kyiv and four regions – Ukrenergo
summary: As of the morning of October 30, consumers in Kyiv and four regions were left without electricity due to Russian attacks. Power consumption restrictions of up to 2.5 scheduled outage slots are in effect in parts of Ukraine.

title: Humanitarian aid being delivered to Oleshky, 25 buses with 750 seats ready for evacuation – Lubinets
summary: Ukraine's Human Rights Commissioner, Dmytro Lubinets, said that 25 buses with a total capacity of 750 seats had been prepared to evacuate residents of Oleshky, along with ambulances for people with limited mobility. Humanitarian aid is also being delivered to the town.

title: Latvia to chair UN Security Council for first time, with Ukraine among its priorities
summary: In November, Latvia will hold the presidency of the UN Security Council for the first time in history, committing to prioritize the situation in Ukraine and the challenges and opportunities presented by new technologies.

title: Russian drones attack four districts of Kyiv region over past 24 hours
summary: The aftermath of Russian drone attacks was reported in four districts of the Kyiv region over the past 24 hours.

title: Eleven people remain hospitalized after Russian strike on Dnipro railway station
summary: Eleven people injured in a Russian attack on the Dnipro railway station remain in city hospitals.

title: Russian forces launch over 20 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region overnight
summary: Russian forces attacked four districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region with drones more than 20 times overnight.

title: Russian airstrike on Izium: Bodies of four victims recovered from rubble
summary: Rescuers have recovered the bodies of four people from the rubble of a building in Izium, Kharkiv region.

title: War update: Over 200 clashes along front line as Russian forces attack in eight sectors
summary: A total of 211 combat engagements were recorded along the front line on October 29. The heaviest fighting took place in the Kostiantynivka, Pokrovsk and Huliaipole sectors.

title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill one, injure another, damage homes and businesses
summary: One person was killed and another injured in Russian ballistic missile and drone attacks on Kyiv that began in the evening of October 29.

title: Drones strike Russian oil refinery and military canning plant, media report
summary: Overnight on October 30, a group of drones struck the Novokuybyshevsk Oil Refinery in Russia’s Samara region.

title: Air defenses down three missiles, 96 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized three aerial missiles and 96 unmanned aerial vehicles used by Russian forces to attack the country overnight on October 30. Enemy strikes were recorded at 17 locations.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,590 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian troops in Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 30, 2026, amount to approximately 1,586,500 personnel, including 1,590 over the past 24 hours.

title: Norwegian delegation sees rescue equipment damaged by Russian attacks in Ukraine
summary: Ukraine showed to its Norwegian partners rescue equipment damaged and destroyed by Russian attacks and shared its experience of responding to strikes on energy facilities and dealing with their aftermath.
